definition: Perceptual disturbance is a problem in how sensory information is processed, separate from a person’s thoughts or feelings about the body. In this source, it refers to altered perception involved in judging body size, beyond body image concerns alone.

reasons: The definition adds a broad characterization of perceptual disturbance as a general problem in sensory-information processing separate from thoughts or feelings; the packet only discusses a possible additional perceptual component in body-size estimation.
